ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Useful for protecting wires through drilled panels; these serve a different purpose from my recent eyelet grommet kit.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Handy for general workshop repairs where my double-sided tape and hook-and-loop strips would not work.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Acrylic Sheet 12" x 16" x 1/8", Cranviech 2 Pack Black Cast Plexiglass Sheets Glass Alternative for Sign DIY Display Projects Photo Frame Craft Handcraft Painting; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I could use these for small fabricated panels, combining them with my drilling and fastening supplies.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: FOLIV 318pcs Grade 8 Heavy Duty Nuts and Bolts Assortment Kit, 1/4-20,5/16-18,3/8-16 Hex Bolts Nuts Washers Assortment Kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The inch sizes would complement my metric bolt kits and overlap with sizes in my UNC rivet-nut assortment.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Okebond Super Glue Clear Strong Repair (Blue OB-4700+1pcs); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A quick adhesive would be useful for small repairs where mixing my epoxy would be inconvenient.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: [40 Pack] 1/4" x 1-1/4" OD Stainless Steel Fender Washer - Choose Size Metal Flat Washers for Bolts, 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The wide washers could help spread fastening pressure on thin panels in my DIY projects.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 3D Printer Resin, JAYO 1KG 3D Resin for 4K 8K LCD/DLP/SLA 3D Printers, 405nm Standard Photopolymer Fast Curing Resin, High Precision, Low Shrinkage, Clear Blue 1000g; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My casting epoxy purchase does not imply a resin printer, and I have no current use for printer-specific resin.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Eventek Infrared Thermometer Gun, [3 in 1] -58°F~1112°F (-50°C~600°C) Digital Laser Temperature Gun for Cooking, Pizza Oven, Grill & Engine with Adjustable Emissivity, Meat Thermometer & Bag Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought an infrared thermometer, so another one would duplicate a tool I already have.
